definitions.explanation: The outer layer or exterior of something.
What appears on the outside, as opposed to what is hidden or internal.

examples.japanese: {水|みず}の{表面|ひょうめん}に{氷|こおり}が{張|は}っている。
examples.english: Ice has formed on the surface of the water.

examples.japanese: {表面|ひょうめん}は{平|へい}{和|わ}に{見|み}えるが、{内|うち}{部|ぶ}では{問題|もんだい}がある。
examples.english: On the surface it looks peaceful, but there are problems inside.

examples.japanese: {表面|ひょうめん}{張力|ちょうりょく}について{学|まな}んだ。
{表面|ひょうめん}{的|てき}には{仲|なか}がいいように{見|み}える。
examples.english: On the surface, they seem to get along well.
examples.notes: {表面|ひょうめん}{的|てき} = superficial, on the surface

examples.japanese: {表面|ひょうめん}{上|じょう}は{賛成|さんせい}しているが、{本当|ほんとう}は{反対|はんたい}だろう。
examples.english: On the surface they agree, but they're probably against it in reality.
examples.notes: {表面|ひょうめん}{上|じょう} = superficially, ostensibly

examples.japanese: {机|つくえ}の{表面|ひょうめん}を{磨|みが}いた。
examples.english: I polished the surface of the desk.

notes:
{表面|ひょうめん} means surface — both the physical outer layer of an object and figuratively the outward appearance of a situation.

PHYSICAL SENSE:
- {水|みず}の{表面|ひょうめん}: water surface
- {表面|ひょうめん}を{磨|みが}く: to polish the surface
- {表面|ひょうめん}{張力|ちょうりょく}: surface tension (physics)

FIGURATIVE SENSE:
- {表面|ひょうめん}{上|じょう}: superficially, on the surface
- {表面|ひょうめん}{的|てき}（な）: superficial
- {表面|ひょうめん}は〜だが: on the surface it seems ~, but...

ANTONYM:
{裏面|りめん}: reverse side, back surface.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {外見|がいけん}: outward appearance (of people)
- {見|み}かけ: appearance (casual)
